entities.summary: James "Athenian" Stuart was a British archaeologist, architect and artist, best known for publishing carefully measured architectural prints, including the smallest details, of key buildings of Ancient Greek architecture in The Antiquities of Athens and Other Monuments of Greece (1762), a pioneering work in the development of Neoclassicism in Britain.
